any religious act or rite (as sacrifice, oblation &c., esp. as originating in the hope of future recompense and as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of spirit), RV.; AV.; VS.; Ragh. &c.
work, labour, activity (as opposed to rest, प्रशान्ति), Hit.; RPrāt. &c.

(in Gr.) the object (it stands either in the acc. [in active construction], or in the nom. [in passive construction], or in the gen. [in connection with a noun of action]; opposed to कर्तृ the subject), Pāṇ. i, 4, 49 ff. (it is of four kinds, viz. a. निर्वर्त्य, when anything new is produced, e.g. कटं करोति, ‘he makes a mat’ ; पुत्रं प्रसूते, ‘she bears a son’; b. विकार्य, when change is implied either of the substance and form, e.g. काष्ठं भस्म करोति, ‘he reduces fuel to ashes’; or of the form only, e.g. सुवर्णं कुण्डलं करोति, ‘he fashions gold into an earring’; c. प्राप्य, when any desired object is attained, e.g. ग्रामं गच्छति, ‘he goes to the village’; चन्द्रं पश्यति, ‘he sees the moon’; d. अनीप्सित, when an undesired object is abandoned, e.g. पापं त्यजति, ‘he leaves the wicked’)
former act as leading to inevitable results, fate (as the certain consequence of acts in a previous life), Pañcat.; Hit.; Buddh., (cf. कर्म-पाक and -विपाक)
the tenth lunar mansion, VarBṛS. &c.
a: कर्मन् — n. [कृ-मनिन् Uṇ. 4. 144] 1 Action, work, deed. --2 Execution, performance. --3 Business, office, duty; संप्रति विषवैद्यानां कर्म M. 4. --4 A religious rite (it may be either नित्य, नैमित्तिक or काम्य). --5 A specific action, moral duty. --6 (a) Performance of religious rites as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of Brahman (opp. ज्ञान); R. 8. 20. (b) Labour, work. --7 Product, result. --8 A natural or active property (as support of the earth). --9 Fate, the certain consequence of acts done in a former life; कर्मायत्तं फलं पुंसां बुद्धिः कर्मानुसारिणी Bh. 2. 89, 94. --10 (In gram.) The object of an action; कर्तुरीप्सिततमं कर्म P. I. 4. 49. --11 (In Vaiś. phil.) Motion considered as one of the seven categories of things; thus defined: --एकद्रव्यमगुणं संयोगविभोगष्वनपेक्षकारणं कर्म Vaiś. Sūt. (It is five-fold: --उत्क्षेपणं ततोऽवक्षेपणमाकुंचनं तथा . प्रसारणं च गमनं कर्मांण्येतानि पंच च .. Bhāṣā P. 6.) --12 Organ of sense. --13 (In astr.) The tenth lunar mansion. --Comp. --अक्षम a. incapable of doing anything. --अंगं part of any act; part of a sacrificial rite (as प्रयाज of the Darśā sacrifice). --अधिकारः the right of performing religious rites. --अनुरूप a. {1} according to action or any particular office. {2} according to actions done in a previous existence. --अनुष्ठानं practising one's duties. --अनुसारः consequence of, or conformity to, acts. --अंतः {1} the end of any business or task. {2} a work, business, execution of business. {3} a barn, a store of grain &c. Ms. 7. 62 (कर्मातः इक्षुधान्यादि संग्रहस्थानं Kull.). {4} cultivated ground. --अंतरं {1} difference or contrariety of action. {2} penance, expiation. {3} suspension of a religious action. --अंतिक a. final. --(कः) a servant, workman. --अर्ह a. fit or suitable to an the act or rite. --(र्हः) a man. --आजीवः one who maintains himself by some profession (as that of an artisan &c.) --आत्मन् a. endowed with the principles of action, active; Ms. 1. 22. (--m.) the soul. --इंद्रियं an organ of action, as distinguished from ज्ञानेंद्रिय; (they are: --वाक्पाणिपादपायूपस्थानि; Ms. 2. 99; see under इंद्रिय also). --उदारं any valiant or noble act, magnanimity, prowess. --उद्युक्त a. busy, engaged, active, zealous. --करः {1} a hired labourer (a servant who is not a slave); कर्मकराः स्थपत्यादयः Pt. 1; Śi. 14. 16. {2} Yama. --कर्तृ m. (in gram.) an agent who is at the same time the object of the action; e. g. पच्यते ओदनः, it is thus defined: --क्रियमाणं तु यत्कर्म स्वयमेव प्रसिध्यति . सुकरैः स्वैर्गुणैः कर्तुः कर्मकर्तेति तद्विदुः ... --कांडः, --डं that department of the Veda which relates to ceremonial acts and sacrificial rites and the merit arising from a due performance thereof. --कारः {1} one who does any business, a mechanic, artisan (technically a worker not hired). {2} any labourer in general (whether hired or not). {3} a black-smith; हरिणाक्षि कटाक्षेण आत्मानमवलोकय . न हि खड्गो विजानाति कर्मकारं स्वकारणम् .. Udb. {4} a bull. --कारिन् m. a labourer, artisan, workman. --कार्मुकः, --कं a strong bow. --कीलकः a washerman. --क्षम a. able to perform any work or duty; आत्मकर्मक्षमं देहं क्षात्रो धर्म इवाश्रितः R. 1. 13. --क्षेत्रं the land of religious acts, that is, भरतवर्ष; cf. कर्मभूमि. --गृहीत a. caught in the very act (as a thief). --घातः leaving off or suspending work. --चं(चां) डालः {1} ‘base in deed’, a man of very low acts or deeds; Vasiṣṭha mentions these kinds: --असूयकः पिशुनश्च कृतघ्नो दीर्घरोषकः . चत्वारः कर्मचांडाला जन्मतश्चापि पंचमः ... {2} one who commits an atrocious deed; U. 1. 46. {3} N. of Rāhu. --चेष्टा active exertion, action. --चोदना {1} the motive impelling one to ritual acts. {2} any positive rule enjoining a religious act. --ज a. resulting from an act. --(जः) {1} the holy fig-tree. {2} the Kali age. {3} the banian tree. {4} the effect arising from human acts: --संयोग, विभाग &c. {5} heaven. {6} hell. --ज्ञ a. one acquainted with religious rites. --त्यागः renunciation of worldly duties or ceremonial acts. --दुष्ट a. corrupt in action, wicked, immoral, disrespectable. --दोषः {1} sin, vice; Ms. 6. 61, 95. {2} an error, defect, or blunder (in doing an act); Ms. 1. 104. {3} evil consequence of human acts. {4} discreditable conduct. --धारयः N. of a compound, a subdivision of Tatpuruṣa, (in which the members of the compound are in apposition); तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येनाहं स्यां बहुव्रीहिः Udb. --ध्वंसः {1} loss of fruit arising from religious acts. {2} disappointment. --नामन् (in gram.) a participial noun. --नाशा N. of a river between Kāśī and Vihāra. --निष्ठ a. devoted to the performance of religious acts. --न्यासः renunciation of the result of religious acts. --पथः {1} the direction or source of an action. {2} the path of religious rites (opp. ज्ञानमार्ग). --पाकः ripening of actions, reward of actions done in a former life; Pt. 1. 372. --प्रवचनीयः a term for certain prepositions, particles, or adverbs when they are not connected with verbs and govern a noun in some case; e. g. आ in आ मुक्तेः संसारः is a कर्मप्रवचनीय; so अनु in जपमनु प्रावर्षत् &c.; cf. उपसर्ग, गति and निपात also. --फलं fruit or reward of actions done in a former life; (pain, pleasure). --बंधः, --बंधनं confinement to repeated birth, as the consequence of religious acts, good or bad (by which the soul is attached to worldly pleasures &c.). --भूः, भूमिः f. {1} the land of religious rites, i. e. भरतवर्ष, this world (a place for man's probation); प्राप्येमां कर्मभूमिं Bh. 2. 100, K. 174, 319. {2} ploughed ground. --मीमांसा the Mīmāṃsā of ceremonial acts; see मीमांसा. --मूलं a kind of sacred grass called कुश. --युगं the fourth (the present) age of the world, i. e. the Kaliyuga. --योगः {1} performance of actions, worldly and religious rites. {2} active exertion, industry. --वचनं (with Buddhists) the ritual. --वज्रः an epithet of a Śūdra. --वशः fate considered as the inevitable result of actions done in a former life. --वाटी a lunar day (तिथि). --विपाक = कर्मपाक. --शाला a work-shop. --शील, --शूर a. assiduous, active, laborious. --शौचं humility. --संगः attachment to worldly duties and their results. --सचिवः a minister. --संन्यासिकः, --संन्यासिन् m. {1} a religious person who has withdrawn from every kind of worldly act. {2} an ascetic who performs religious deeds without looking to their reward. --साक्षिन् m. {1} an eye-witness; Ku. 7. 83. {2} one who witnesses the good or bad actions of man; (there are nine divinities which are said to witness and watch over all human actions; सूर्यः सोमो यमः कालो महाभूतानि पंच च . एते शुभाशुभस्येह कर्मणो नव साक्षिणः ..) --सिद्धिः f. accomplishment of any business or desired object; success. --स्थानं a public office, a place of business.

k.v: प्रकृतिप्रत्ययार्थाद्यैः सङ्कीर्णे लिङ्गमुन्नयेत्. कर्म क्रिया तत्सातत्ये गम्ये स्युरपरस्पराः॥

कर्मन्दिन् m. one who studies Karmanda's work, ib.
a beggar (= भिक्षु), L.

(scil. शब्द; in Gr.) a term for certain prepositions or particles not connected with a verb but generally governing a noun (either separated from it or forming a compound with it; a Karma-pravacanīya never loses its accent, and exercises no euphonic influence on the initial letter of a following verb; see also उप-सर्ग, गति, and निपात), Pāṇ. i, 4, 83-98; ii, 3, 8, &c.
कर्म—राष्ट्र N. of a country, Inscr.
कर्म—˚र्घ (कर्म + ऋघ fr. ऋघा) m. N. of a teacher.
कर्मरी f. the manna of the bamboo, L.

कर्म—रङ्ग m. Averrhoa Carambola, R. (cf. -फल above.)
कर्मरक m. id. (cf. कर्म-रङ्ग.)

k.v: भानुर्हंसः सहस्रांशुस्तपनः सविता रविः। पद्माक्षस्तेजसांराशिश्छायानाथस्तमिस्रहा। कर्मसाक्षी जगच्चक्षुर्लोकबन्धुस्त्रयीतनुः। प्रद्योतनो दिनमणिः खद्योतो लोकबान्धवः। इनो भगो धामनिधिश्चांशुमाल्यब्जिनीपतिः। माठरः पिङ्गलो दण्डश्चण्डांशोः पारिपार्श्वकाः॥

m: कर्म—सारथि m. a companion, assistant, BhP.
कर्म—स्थान n. public office or place of business, Rājat.
a stage or period in the life of an Ājīvika (q.v.), T.
कर्म—स्थ mfn. contained or being in the object.
कर्म—सूत्र n. N. of wk.

कर्म—सङ्ग m. attachment to action, Bhag.
कर्म—सङ्—˚गिन् mfn. attached to action, ib.

k.v: राजन्यकं च नृपतिक्षत्रियाणां गणे क्रमात्. मन्त्री धीसचिवोऽमात्योऽन्ये कर्मसचिवास्ततः॥

कर्म—सिद्धि f. accomplishment of an act, success, Mālav.; Kum.
कर्म—स्तव m. N. of wk.
कर्म—स्वक mfn. one who has to bear the consequence of his acts, Buddh.
कर्म—ता f.
कर्म—तत्त्व-प्रदीपिका f. N. of wk.
कर्म—त्व n. the state or effect of action &c., Car.; Sarvad. &c.
activity
the state of being an object Comm. on TPrāt.
कर्म—त्याग m. abandonment of worldly duties or ceremonial rites, W.
कर्म—वाद m. a text relating to sacrificial rites, Baudh.

Butea frondosa, Nigh.

v: na॰ 6 ta॰ । vihitasya yAgAdikarmaRo'Nge yaTA darSAdeH prayAjAdi । deSakAlAdayo'pi karmANgAni । yaTAha gargaH--“tiTinakzatravArAdi sADanaM puRyapApayoH । praDAna guRaBAvena svAtantryeRa na te kzamAH” । “praDAnasya viDeyasya karmaRo guRaBAvenANgatvena, taduktaM “karmAsannihitaM nEva budDO viparivarttate । SabdAttu tadupasTAnamupAdeye guRoBavet” BawwakA॰ “pramARAntarAsannihitaM karma budDO praTamaM na vizayIBavati prATamikaSabdAdeva tasya karmaRa upasTitiriti upAdeye svaviDeye karmmaRi pUjAdO candrAdikriyAtvena tadavacCinnakAlatvena vA SucitatkAlajIvinaH karmADikArAt pramARAntaralaByatvenAviDeyatvAttiTyAdirguRaH” ti॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । “PalavatsanniDAvaPalaM tadaNgamiti” nyAyena PalavatprakaraRe paWitAnAmaPalAnAM sarvezAM tadaNgatvamavaDeyam ।

Qa iti saMjYA kftA । atra dvitIyA viBaktirBavati । tasmin ukte praTamA । tasya lakzaRam । “parasamavetaDAtvarTajanyaPalaSAlitvaM karmmatvam” । iti sAramaYjarI ॥ “yatkriyate tat” । iti prasidDam । jYAnaSezatAYcAvaDArya nizkAmezu karmasu pravarttayate । paRqitenApi mUrKaH kAmye karmaRi na pravarttayitavyaH ityAha zazWaskanDe--“svayaM niHSreyasaM vidvAn na vaktyajYAya karma hi । na rAti rogiRe'paTyaM vAYCate'pi BizaktamaH” । rAti dadAti” । ma॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । idamapi jYAnanizWApraSaMsAmAtram anyaTA saMsArasya DarmmADarmmamUlakatayA DarmmakAryyasya PalABAve kaTaM suKAdiBogaH, kaTaM vA saMsArapravfttiH । kiYca ISvaraSabde darSite “Palamata upapatteH” ityAdike SA॰ sUtraBAzye Darmmasya PaladAtftvamatanivAraReneSvarasyEva PaladAtftvaM yaduktaM tadvirudDaM syAt । ekAntato'sati karmaRaH Pale kaTamISvarasya taddAtftvoktiH saNgacCate । ataeva tatrEva BAga॰ 11, 3, 46 । “parokzavAdo vedo'sO bAlAnAmanuSAsanam । karmamokzAya karmARi viDatte tvagadaM yaTA” iti pUrvvataravAkye karmaRAM karmamokzasyEva muKyaPalatvamuktaM na tu PalABAvaH । vyAkftaYcEtat SrIDareRa yaTA--“nanu svargAdyarTaM karmARi viDatte na karmamokzArTaM tatrAha bAlAnAmanuSAsanaM yaTA Bavati taTA tatra dfzwAntaH agadam OzaDa yaTA pitA bAlamagadaM pAyayan KaRqalaqqakAdiBiH praloBayan pAyayati dadAti ca tAni, nEtAvatA'gadapAnasya tallABaH prayojanaM api cArogyaM taTA vedo'pyavAntaraPalEH praloBayan karmamokzAyEva karmARi viDatte” । tatra dfzwAnte dadAti ca tAnIti vadatA dArzwAntike'pi KaRqalaqqukAdidAnavat PalavattvaM sUcitaM kintu tasya na muKyoddeSyatvam taccArogyasTAnIyamokzasyEveti susTitaM karmmaRaH Palavattvamiti dik ।
strI karmma nayati samAptim nI--bA॰ qi Ratvam । karmmasamAptO karttavyAyAM prAyaScittezwO । “karmmaRireva tatra prAyaScittiH” Sata॰ 6, 6, 4, 9 ।

s: strI, (karmmaRA sampadyate tatra sADuriti yat । wAp ca .) vetanam । mUlyam । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 38 ॥

tri, (karmmaRi sADuH tatra sADuriti yat । yadvA karmmaRA sampAdi .) karmmayogyaH । kriyArhaH । kejuyA iti BAzA । karmmaRA BrAjate ityarTe yapratyayaH । iti saMkziptasAravyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA, fgvede 1 । 91 । 20 । “somovIraM karmmaRyaM dadAti” ॥)
v: tri॰ karmmaRA sampAdi yat । 1 karmmaRA sampanne SO ryyesi॰ kO॰ । karmmaRi sADuyat । 2 karmakuSale si॰ kO॰ । “yato vIraH karmaRyaH sudakzaH” f॰ 3, 4, 9 । “akarmaRyaM tiTimalaM vidyAdekAdaSIM vinA” ti॰ ta॰ । 3 vetane strI kzIrasvAmI । vetanena hi karmasADanAt tasya taTAtvam ।
tri॰ karmaRyAM vetanaM BuNkte Buja--kvip 6 ta॰ NyAporiti hrasvaH । vetanena karmakArake BaraRyaBugityaBarapAWAntaramiti kzIra॰ ।

s: tri, (karmmaRyaM vetanaM BuNkte । Buj + kvip .) BaraRyaBuk । vetanIpajIvI । ityamarawIkAyAM svAmI ॥

v: strI karmmaRaH SilpAdeH SAlA । SilpAdeH SAlAyAm । “gatvA tu tAM BArgavakarmaSAlAm” । “jagAma BArgavakarmmaSAlAm” BA॰ A॰ 19, 10

s: tri, (karmma SIlaM karmmakaraRarUpasvaBAvo yasya । karmma SIlayatIti vA .) yaH PalanirapekzaH svaBAvataH karmma karoti saH । tatparyyAyaH । kArmmaH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 18 ॥

s: tri, (karmmaRi SUraH dakzaH .) karmmaWaH । PalaparyyantakarmmasamApakaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 18 ॥
v: pu॰ karmmaRi SUraH । prayatnena 1 prArabDakarmmasamApake, APalodayaM 2 karmmakAriRi ca ।
pu॰ । 1 puMlahaputraBede “pulahasya gatirBAryyA trInasUtasatI sutAn । karmmaSrezWaM varIyAMsaM sahizRuYca mahAmate!” BAga॰ 4, 1, 31 । karmmaRA SrezWaH । 2 karmakAryyakaraRena varizWe tri॰ ।

s: tri, (karmmaRi Gawate iti । “karmmaRi Gawo'Wac” । 5 । 2 । 35 । iti aWac .) karmmakuSalaH । yaTA । BawwiH । 1 । 11 । “jYAtASayastasya tato vyatAnIt sa karmmaWaH karmmasutAnubanDam” ॥ prayatnena prArabDaM karmma samApayati yaH । tatparyyAyaH karmmaSUraH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 18 ॥
v: tri॰ karmaRi Gawate karmman + aWac । karmmanizpAdanArTaM GawamAne । “sa karmaWaH karmma sutAnubanDi” BawwiH ।

na॰ karmaRA banDaH SarIrasaMbanDaH । 1 karmajanyAdfzwenA pUrbadehasaMbanDarUpe saMsAre “karmabanDaM prahAsyasi” gItA karmabanDanamapyatra । karma banDanaM banDasADanaM yasya । karmarUpabanDanasADanayukte tri॰ । “loko'yaM karma banDanaH” gItA ।

pu॰ karmaRA caRqAla iva । “asUyakaH piSunaSca kataGno dIrGarozakaH । catvAraH karmacaRqAlA janmataScApi paYcamaH” vasizWoktezu asUyakAdizu caturzu । 2 rAhO ca । “uttizWa gamyatAM rAhO! tyajyatAM candrasaNgamaH । karmacaRqAla! yogotTaM mama pApakzayaM kuru” grahaRamuktisnAnamantraH । rAhoSca asUyakatvAddIrGadozavattvAcca taTAtvam ।

strI karmaRi kriyAyE cezwA । kriyAnuzWAnArTaM cezwAyAm “AtmajanyA BavedicCA, icCAjanyA Bavet kftiH । kftijanyA BaveccezwA, cezwAjanyA kriyA Bavet” ityukteH cezwAyAH kriyAhetutvena taTAtvam “karmacezwAsvahaH kfzRaH SuklaH svapnAya SarvarI” manuH ।
tri॰ citavAn ci--BUte kvip 6 ta॰ । 1 kftakarmaRi । karmaRi kvip 6 ta॰ । 2 karmaRA cIyamAne ca “karmamayAn karmacitaste karmaREvADIyante karmaRA cIyante” Sata॰ brA॰ । 10, 5, 3, 9 ।
tri॰ karmaRA citaH ci--kta । karmAnazpAdye “tadyaTeha karmacitolokaH kzIyate evamamutra puRyacitaH” vedapari॰ SrutiH

strI karmaRi karmAvaboDane codanA viDiH । karmavizaye 1 preraRArUpe viDO “karmAvaroDanaM codanA kriyAyAH pravarttakaM vacanamiti” mImA॰ BA॰ । codyate pravarttyate'nayA bA॰ karaRe a 7 ta॰ । 2 karmapravfttihetO jYAnajYeyajYAtfrUpe'rTe ca । “jYAnaM jYeyaM parijYAtA triviDA karmacodanA” gotA । “jYAnamizwasADanamitiboDaH, jYeyamizwasADanaM karma, parijYAtA tajjYAnASrayaH triviDA karmacodanA codyate pravarttyate'nayeti codanA jYAnAditritayaM karmapravfttiheturityarTaH । yadvA codaneti viDirucyate tadukta BawwEH--“codanA copadeSaSca viSizwEkArTavAcinaH” iti tataScAyamarTaH--uktalakzaRaM triguRAtmakaM jYAnAditrayamavalambya karmaviDiH pravarttate iti” SrIDaraH ।

pu॰ karmaRA devaH prAptadevaBAvaH । 1 trayastriMSaddevaBede । “sa ekaH karmadevAnAmAnandaH ye karmaRA devAnapi yanti Srotriyasya cAkAmahatasya te, ye SataM karmadevAnAmAnandAH” tE॰ u॰ । “karmadevA ye vEdikenAgnihotrAdinA kevalena devAnapi yanti, devA iti trayastriSadDavirBujaH । indrastezAM svAmI tasyAcAryyo bfhaspatiH । prajApatirvirAwtrElokya SarIro brahmA samazwivyazwisvarUpaH saMsAramaraRAnalavyApI” SANkara BA॰ । trayastriMSacca devAH AnandagiriRA darSitAH । “azwO vasavaH ekAdaSa rudrAH dvAdaSAdityAH indraH prajApatiSceti” 2 karmaRA devalokaM gate ca । “sa ekaH karmadevAnAmAnando ye karmaRA devatvamaBisampadyante aTa ye SataM karmadevAnAmAnandAH” Sata॰ brA॰ 14, 7, 1, 35 । ye agnihotrAdiSrOtrakarmaRA devalokaM prApnuvanti te karmadevAH” BA॰ । karmadevatA'pyatra strI । “jyotizwomAdinA svargaM prAptAH syuH karmadebatAH” Sabdaci॰ । asmin kalpe'SvameDAdi karma kftvA mahatpadam । avApyAjAnadevEryAH pUjyAstAH karmadevatAH” iti Sabdaci॰ pu॰ ।

pu॰ karmEva dozaH, karmmaRi dozaH, karmaheturdozo vA । 1 duzwe pApajanake hiMsAdO karmaRi । “saMnyasya sarvakarmARi karmadozAnapAnudan” SarIrajEHkarmado zEryAti sTAvaratAM naraH” manuH । 2 karmmajanye pApAdO “manovAgdehajErnityaM karmadozErna lipyate” manuH । “karmadozEH pApEH” kullU॰ । vihitAkaraRAvihitAcaraRarUpe 3 karmavizayadoze ca । “avekzeta gatIrnFRAM karmadozasamudBavAH” manuH । “vihitAkaraRAvihitAcaraRarUpakarmadozajanyA gatIH” kullU॰ । 6 sakalakarmahetO miTyAjYAnajanyavAsanArUpe doze ca । “duHKajanmapravfttidozamiTyAjYAnAnAma” ityAdi॰ gOta॰ sU॰ miTyAjYAnajanyavAsanArUpadozasya sakalapravfttirUpakarmmahetutvoktestasya taTAtvam ।
pu॰ karmaRAM granTirbanDanamasmAt । ajYAnajanya vAsanArUpe doze tasyEva sakalapravfttihetutvAttasya karmabanDanahetutvAttaTAtvam ।

s: puM, (karmmaRo jAtaH । vizayaBogavAsanAvaSAt kramaSaH malinAyamAno vfttiBirjAta ityarTaH । jana + qa .) kaliyugaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ vawavfkzaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ kriyAjanye tri । (yaTA, manuH । 12 । 101 । “taTA dahati vedajYaH karmmajaM dozamAtmanaH” ॥ kAraRaBedena rogaBedo yaTA । “bahuBirupacArEstu yena yAnti samantataH । te karmmajAH samuddizwA vyADayo dAruRAH punaH” ॥ iti hArIte cikitsitasTAne 2 aDyAyaH ॥)
v: tri॰ karmaRo karmajanyAdfzwAt jAyate jana--qa । karmahetuke rogAdO । rogAdivyADayo hi nAnAviDAH yaToktaM BAvapra॰“teza svABAvikAH kecitkecidAgantavaH smftAH । mAnasAH kecidAKyAtAH kaTitAH ke'pi kAyikAH । tatra svABAvikAH SarIrasvaBAbAdeva jAtAH । kzutpipAsA suzuptyA ca jarAmftyupravfttayaH । aTavA svasvaBAvAdutpatte rjAtA svABAvikAH sahajA iti yAvat । te ca janmAnDatvAdayaH । Agantavo'BiGAtAdijanitAH । aTavA janmottaraBAvinaH kAmakroDaloBamohaBayABimAnadEnyapESunyaSokavizAderzyAsUyAmAtsaryyapraBftayaH । aTa vonmAdApasmAramUrcCABramamohatamaH saMnyAsapraBftayaH । kAyikAH pARqurogapraBftayaH । karmajAH kaTitAH keciddozajAH santi cApare । karmadozodBavAScAnye vyADayastriviDAH smftAH । tatra karmajAH vyADaya yatprAktananduzkarmaBavaNkevalaBoganASyam prAyaScittanASya vA tato jAtAH na tu duzwavAtAdidozeRa janitAstaTA । yaTASAstrantu nirRIto yaTAvyADicikitsitaH । na SamaM yAti yo vyADiH sa jYeyaH karmajo buDEH । dozajAH miTyAhAravihAraprakupitavAtapittakaPajAH । nanu miTyAhAravihAriRAmapi prAktanasukftena nErujyaM dfSyata eva । tato dozajezvapi prAktanaM duzkarmEva kAraRam tat kaTaM dozajA ityucyante? । dozayezvapi vastutaH AdikAraRaM duzkarma varttata eva kintu tatra miTyAhAravihAradUzitA dozA hetavo dfSyanta iti dozajA ityucyanta iti samADiH । karmadozIdBavAH । svalpadozA garoyAMsaste jYeyAH karmadozajAH । atrakAraRaM duzkarmaM prabalaM yato dozAlpatve'pi vyADergaMrIyastvantatkarmakzayAdeva kzIRaM Bavati । dozAH svalpA api nidAnatvanoktA dfSyanta eveti dozARAM kAraRatAM manyanta iti । karmaMkzayAt karmakftA dozajAH svasvaBezajEH । karmaMdozodBavA yAnti karmadozakzayAt kzayam । dozajAH svasvaBazajEriti dopajezvAdikAraRam duzkarma tadBezajArTadravyakzayAdijanitaM duHKaBogena kawutiktakazAyAdyahfdyaBakzaRAdijanitaduHKaBogena ca kzayaM yAnti । SezA duzwA hetavo dozAste svasvaBezajEH kzayaM yAntItyarTaH । 2 kAyikavAcikamAnasakarmaBave sTAvarAdijanmani “SuBASuBaPalaM karmma manovAgdehasamBavam । karmajAgatayo nFRAmuttamADamamaDyamAH” 3 karmmajAtamAtre pApAdidoze ca “taTA dahati vedajYaH karmmajaM dozamAtmanaH” manuH । kriyAjanye 4 saMyoge 5 viBAge ca । “aprAptayostu yA prAptiH sEva saMyoga IritaH । kIrttitastriviDastveza Adyo 'nyatarakarmajaH । taToBayakriyAjanyo Bavet saMyogajo'paraH । AdimaH SyenaSElAdisaMyogaH parikIrttitaH । nezayoH sannipAto yaH sa dvitIya udAhftaH । kapAlatarusaMyogAt saMyogastarukumBayoH । tftIyaH syAt karmajo'pi dviDEva parikIrttitaH । aBiGAto nodanaYca SabdaheturihAdimaH । SabdAheturdvitIyaH syAdviBAgo'pi triDA BaGet । ekakarmodBavastvAdyo dvayakarmodBavo'paraH । viBAgajastftIyaH syAt tftIyo'pi dviDA Bavet” BAzA॰ 6 vegAKyasaMskAre ca “mUrttamAtre tu vegaH syAt karmajovegajaH kvacit” BAzA॰ 7 vawavfkze pu॰ jawA॰ । 8 kaliyuge pu॰ Sabdara॰ । kriyAjakarmaBavAdayo'pyatrArTe । 9 DarmADarmmarUpe guRaBede adfzwe vedAntimate karmaRaH sUkzmAvasTApanne 10 saMskAraBede 11 svarge 12 narake ca adfzwadvArA tayoH karmajanyatvAttaTAtvam ।

s: puM, (karmmaRo jAyate yo guRaH kriyAhetoH jAto guRa ityarTaH .) kriyAjanyaguRaH । tadyaTA । “saMyogaSca viBAgaSca vegaScEte tu karmmajA” ॥ iti BAzAparicCede ॥ 97 ॥

v: pu॰ jarAsanDavaMSye mAgaDe nfpaBede “aTa mAgaDarAjAno BAvino ye vadAmi te” BavitA sahadevasya (jarAsanDaputrasya) mArjjAriryacCrutaSravAH । tato'yutAyustasyApi niramiratro'Ta tatsutaH । sunakzatraH sunakzatrAt vfhat seno'Ta karmmajit” BAga॰ 9, 22, 30 ।

na॰ karmaRAM karttavyatApratipAdakaM kARqam । karmaRAM karttavyatApratipAdake vedaBAga karmakARqasyA ramBaprayojanaYca vfha॰ u॰ BAzye darSitaMyaTA । “tatrAsya karmmakARqena sambanDo'BiDIyate । sarvvo'pyayaM vedaH pratyakzAnumAnAByAmanavagatezwAnizwaprAptiparihAropAyaprakASanaparaH sarvvapuruzARAM nisargaMta eva tatprAptiparihArayerizwatvAt । dfzwavizaye cezwAnizwaprAptiparihAropAyajYAnasya pratyakzAnumAnAByAmeva sidDatvAnnAgamAnvezaRA । na cAsati janmAntarasambanDyAtmAstitvavijYAne janmAntarezwAnizwaprAptiparihArecCA syAt svaBAvavAdidarSanAt । tasmAjjanmAntarasambanDyAtmAstitve janmAntarezwAnizwaprAptiparihAropAyaviSeze ca SAstraM pravarttate । “yeyaM prete vicikitsA manuzye'stItyeke nAyamastIti cEke” ityupakramya “astItyevopalabDavyaH” ityevamAdinirRayadarSanAt । “yaTA ca maraRaM prApya” ityupakramya “yonimanye prapadyante SarIratvAya dehinaH । sTARumanye'nusayanti yaTAkarmma yaTASrutam” iti ca, svayaM jyotirityupakramya” taM vidyAkarmmaRI samanvAraBete puRyovE puRyena karmmaRA Bavati” । jYapayizyAmItyupakramya “vijYAnamayaH” iti ca vyatiriktAtmAstitvam । tatpratyakzavizayameveti cenna vAdivipratipattidarSanAt । na hi dehAntarasambanDina AtmanaH pratyakzeRAstitvavijYAne lokAyatikA bOdDASca naH pratikUlAH syuH । nAstyAtmeti vadantaH । na hi GawAdo pratyakzavizaye kaScidvipratipadyate nAsti Gawa iti । sTARvAdO puruzAdidarSanAnneti cet na nirUpite'BAvAt । na hi pratyakzeRa nirUpite sTARvAdO vipratipattirBavati । vEnASikastvahamitipratyaye jAyamAne'pi dehAntaravyatiriktasya nAstitvameva pratijAnate । tasmAt pratyakzavizayavElakzaRyAt pratyakzAnnAtmAstitvasidDiH । taTAnumAnAdapi । SrutyAtmAstitve liNgasyAdarSitatvAt liNgasya ca pratyakzavizayatvAnneti cet na janmAntarasambanDasyA grahaRAt Agamena tvAtmAstitve'vagate vedapradarSitalOkikaliNgaviSezESca tadanusAriRo mImAMsakAstArkikAScAhampratyayaliNgAni ca vEdikAnyeva svamatipraBavAnIti kalpayanto vadAnti pratyakzaScAnumeyaScAtmeti । sarvvaTApyastyAtmA dehAntarasamyanDItyevampratipatturdehAntaragatezwA nizwaprAptiparihAropAyaviSezArTinastadviSezajYApanAya karmmakARqaM samArabDam” । aDikAriBedenEva karmakARqe pravfttiH “loke'smitu dviviDA nizWA purA proktA mayAnaGa! । jYAnayogena sAMKyAnAM karmayogena yoginAm” iti gItAyAmapi dvEviDyokteH ataeva “tametaM brAhmaRAvividizanti vedAnuvacanena yajYena tapasA nASakena” iti SrutyEva karmaRAM vividizAhetutokteH vividizAyAmeva karmakARqapratipAdyakarmaRAmupayoga ityAkare sTitam ।

s: puM, (karmma vetanaM gfhItvA lohAdiBiH KaqgakarttarikAdikaM karoti nirmmAtIti । karmma + kf + upapade “karmmaRyaR” । 3 । 2 । 1 । iti aR .) varRasaNkaraviSezaH । lOhakAraH । kAmAra iti BAzA । sa tu SUdrAyAM viSvakarmmaRo jAtaH । iti brahmavEvarttapurARam ॥ vfzaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥
tri, (karmma karoti mftimfte । karmma + kf + aR .) vetanaM vinA BAravahanAdikarmmakArakaH । vegAra iti BAzA ॥ tatparyyAyaH । karmmakriyaH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 19 ॥
v: tri॰ karmma karoti aBftyA aR upa॰ sa॰ । vinA vetanena 1 karmmakArake (vegAra) (kAmAra) iti prasidDa saNkIrRajAtiBede jAtiSabde vivftiH । “hariRAkzi! kawAkzeRa AtmAnamavalokaya । nahi KaqgovijAnAti karmmakAraM svakAraRam” udBawaH ।

“kvacidekasya karmaRo'nekakAryyakAritvamAha kAraRamityanuzaNgaH yatra dravye karmotpannaM tena samaM yAvaddravyaM saMyuktamAsIt tAvatsaNKyakAn viBAgAn janayitvA tAvataH saMyogAnapi punaranyatra janayati vegaM punarekameva svASraye karoti vegapadaM sTitisTApakasapyupalakzayati” upaska॰ “na dravyARAM karma” sU॰ । “nanu kriyA yatA dravyeRAramBakasaMyoge janite tena ca dravyamArabDa yattadapi karmajanyameva karmaRastatpUrvvavarttitvAdata Aha karma dravyARAM na kAraRamityarTaH । kuta evamata Aha” upaska॰ “vyatirekAt” sU॰ । “vyatirekAditi nivftterityarTaH uttarasaMyogena karmaRi vivftte dravyamutpadyate iti na karmaRodravyakAraRatvaM vinaSyadavasTaYca karmana dravyakAraRam । kiYca karma dravyasyAsamavAyi kAraRaM vA BavennimittakAraRaM vA, na tAvadAdyaH, dravyasyAsamavAyikAraRanASanASyatvena avayavakarmanASAdeva dravyanASApatteH । na dvitIyaH, mahApawanASe'vasTitasaMyogeBya eva KaRqaprawotpattO nizkarmaRAmevAvayavAnAM dravyAramBadarSanAdvyaBicArAt” upaska॰ । “guRavEDarmyAnna karmaRAM karmma” sU॰ । “nanu yaTA dravyARAM dravyaM kAryyaM guRAnAYca guRastaTA kiM karmaRAmapi karma kAryyam? ityata Aha kAryyamiti SezaH dravyaguRayoH sajAtIyAramBakatvaM sADarmyamuktaM “tatra karma karmasADyaM na vidyate” iti sUtreRa karmaRAM karmajanakatvaM pratizidDameva tadihAnUdyate iti mAvaH” upaska॰ । “asamavAyAt sAmAnyakAryyaM karma na vidyate” sU॰ “asamavAyAdityatra dravyayordravyezviti yojyaM, taTA ca na dravyayorekaM karmasamavEti na vA dravyezvekaM karma samavEti tena sAmAnyasya । dAyasya kAryyaM karma na vidyate । atrApi vidirjYAnATo na sattAvacanaH yadi karmavyAsajyavftti syAt! ekasmin calati, dvayordravyayorbahuzu ca dravyezu calatIti pratyayaH syAt! nacEtat, tasmAnnakama vyAsajyavfttItyarTaH । nanu SarIratadavayavAnAM karma SarIratadavayavErbahuBirAraByata eva kaTamanyaTA SarIre calati karacaraRAdAvapi calatIti pratyayaH, evamanyatrApyavayavinIti cenna avayabikarmasAmagryA avayavakarmasAmagrIvyAptatvAt taTopalabDeH na tu vEparItyam, nahyavayave calati sarvatrAvayavini calatIti pratyayaH anyaTA kAraRAkAraRasaMyogAt kAryyAkAryyasaMyogo'pi na syAt, kAraRakarmaREva kAryyasyApi saMyogopapatteH” upaska॰ “nanu mUrttaguRAnAM kAryyARAM kAraRaguRapUrvakatvaM svASrayaguRapUrvvakatvaYcoktaM dravyakarmaRoSca na karma kAraRamityuktaM, taTA ca karmaRaH kimapi na kAryyamityAyAtaM, taTAcAtIndriyARAM sUryyAdigatInAm anumAnamapi durlaBaM, liNgABAvAt ataH saMyogaviBAgavegAnAM karmeti sUtroktameva smArayannAha “saMyogaviBAgASca karmaRAm” sU॰ “janyAiti SezaH vyaktyaBiprAyeRa bahuvacanaM saMskAro'pyuzalakzaRIyaH । nanu dravyakarmaRI na karma kAryye iti pUrvamuktam, saMyogaviBAgO tu saMyomaviBAgakAnAMveva, taTA cedAnIM karmaRaH kAraRatvABiDAnaM virudDAmatyata Aha” upaska॰ । “kAraRasAmAMnye dravyakarmaRAM karmAkAraRamuktam” sU॰ । “kAraRa sAmAnyapadena tatprakaraRamupalakzyAte tena kAraRasAmAnyABiDAnaprakaraRe dravyakarmaRI prati karmaRo'kAraRatvamuktaM na tu sarvaTApyakAraRameva karmeti vivakzita yena “saMyogaviBAgASca karmaRAmiti” sUtraMvyAhanyeteti BAvaH” upaska॰ । tacca karma paYcaviDam “utkzepaRaM tayAvakzepaRamAkuYcanaM taTA । prasAraRaYca gamanaM karmARyetAni paYca ca” BAzA॰ atredaM boDyam । kfYoyatrArTakatvabAdimate 'sya yatnArTakakfDAtunizpannatve'pi uktalakzaRakriyAmAtre rUQatvaM na tu yOgikatvam । tacca karttfSabdepradarSite karmAdiSabdavat karttfpadasya rUQatvapratipAdanapare Sabdaci॰ vAkye uktam । kfYa utpattyanukUlavyApAramAtrArTakatvavAdimate tu yOgikatvamiti BedaH । vyAkarasRamate 3 vyApAramAtrarUpakriyAyAm “vyApAroBAvanA sEvotpAdanA sEva ca kriyA । kfYo'karmakattApatternahi yatro'rTa izyate” iti hariRA kfYoyatnArTakatvanirAsena karmaparyyAyakriyASabdasya vyApArArTakatvasyokteH । kriyA ca DAtfpAttavyApAraBedaH aDikaM kriyASabde vakzyate । 4 SAstravihite agnihotrAdiyAgAdO tacca triviDam “nityaM nEmittikaM kAmyaM karmma cEvaM triDA matam” iti vyAsokteH । tatra nityamakaraRepratyavAyAnubanDi sanDyAvandanAdi । nEmittikaM nimittaniScayADInakarttavyatAkaM jAtezwyAdi । kAmyaM kAmanAvatkarttavyamaSvameDAdi । punaH prakArAntareRa tattriviDaM sAtvikarAjasatAmasaBedAt । tallakzaRanyuktAni gItAyAM yaTA “niyataM saNgarahitamarAgadvezataH kftam । aPalaprepsunA karmma yattat sAtvikamucyate 1 । yattu kAmepsunA karmma sAhaNkAreRa । vA punaH । kriyate bahulAyAsaM tadrAjasamudAhftam 2 । anubanDaM kzayaM hiMsAmanapekzya ca pOruzam । mohAdAraByate karmma tattAmasamudAhftam” 3 । “niyataM nityatayA vihitaM, saNgarahitamaBiniveSaSUnyam । arAgadvezataH putrAdiprItyA vA SatrudvezeRa vAM yat kftaM na Bavati PalaM prAptumicCatIti PalaprapsustadvilakzaRena nizkAmeRa kartrA yat kftaM karmma tat sAtvikamucyate 1 । yattu karma kAmepsunA PalaM prAptumicCunA sAhaNkAreRa vA matsamaH ko'nyaH Srotriyo'stItyeva nirUQAhaNkArayuktena ca kriyate tacca punarbahulAyAsamatikleSayuktam tadrAjasamudAhftam 2 । anubaDyata ivyanubanDaM paScAdBAvi SuBASuBaM kzayaM vittakzayaM hiMsAM parapIqAM pOruzaYca svasAmarTyamanapekzyAparyyAlocya kevalaM mohAdeva yat karmmAraByate tattAmasamudAhftam” 3 SrIDaraH । prakArAntareRa tattriviDaM SuklakfzRakfzRaSuklaBedAt tatra SuklaM hiMsAdyanapekzaM puRyajanakaM svADyAyAdi । krazRaM SAstranizidDaM pApajanakaM brahmahatyAdi । kfzRaSuklam hiMsAdisahitaM vedavihitaM puRyApuRyajanakaM paSuyAgAdi । karmavipAkaSabde udA॰ । tacca prakArAnta reRa dviviDaM pravfttaM nivfttaM ca yaTAha manuH “iha cAmutra vA kAmyaM pravfjYaM karmma kIrttyate । nizkAmaM jYAnapUrvantu nivfttamupadiSyate । pravfttaM karmma saMsevya devAnAmeti sArzwitAm । nivfttaM sevyamAnantu BUtAnyatyeti paYca vE” । “kAmanApUrvakaM karmma SatIrapravfttihetutvAt pravfttaM, tadeva karma kAmanArahitaM punarbrahmajYAnAByAsapUrbakaM saMsAra, nivfttihetutvAt nivfttamucyate” mala॰ ta॰ raGuna॰ sADu karmakArayati taM yameBya unninIzate ezaM u evAsADu karmakArayatIti” SrutiH । “PalaM karmAyattam” mImAMsakAH ।

SarIrayAtrApi ca te na prasidDyedakarmaRaH । yajYArTAt karmaRo'nyatra loko'yaM karmabanDanaH । tadarTaM karma kOnteya! muktasaNgaH samAcAra । saha yajYAH prajAH sfzwvA purovAca prajApatiH । anena aGAyurindriyArAmomoGaM pArTa! sa jIvati । yastvAtmaratireva syAdAtmatfptaSca mAnavaH । Atmanyeva ca saMtuzwastasya kAryyaM na vidyate । nEva tasya kftenArTonAkfteneha kaScana । na cAsya sarvvaBUtezu karma kurvannApnoti kilvizam । yadfcCAlABasantuzwodvandvAtItovimatsaraH । samaH sidDAvasidDO ca kftvApi na nibaDyate । gatasaNgasya muktasya jYAnAvasTitacetasaH । yajYAyAcarataH karma samagraM niHSreyasakarAvuBO । tayostu karmasaMnyAsAt karmayogo viSizyate । jYeyaH sa nityaH saMnyAsI yo na dvezwi na kANkzati । nirdvanvo hi mahAvAho! suKaM banDAt pramucyate । sAMKyayogO pfTagbAlAH pravadanti । evaM gItAyAM nAnAsTAneza PalABisanDityAgenEva karmaRAM paramparayA mokzasADanatvamuktamanupadaM vakzyamARa pAta॰ BAzye ceSvarArpaRabudDyAnuzWIyamAnAnAM yogasAGanatvokteSca mumukzuRA sUtraBAzyavivaraRezUktaM yaTA“tapaHsvADyAyeSvarapraRiDAnAni kriyAyogaH” sU॰ । “uddizwaH samAhitacittasya yogaH, kaTaM vyutTitacitto'pi yogayuktaH syAdityetadAraByate । nAtapasvino yogaH sidDyati anAdikarmakleSavAsanAcitrA pratyupasTitavizayajAlA cASudDirnAntareRa tapaHsamBedamapodyate iti tapasa upAdAnaM tacca cittaprasAdanamabADamAnamanenAsevyamiti manyate, svADyAyaH praRavAdipavitrARAM drAgityeva samBavata iti dvitIyapAdopadeSyAnupAyAnapekzate satvaSudDyarTaM, tato hi viSudDasatvaH kftarakzAsaMviDAno'ByAsavErAgye pratyahaM BAvayati । samAhitatvamavikziptatvaM, kaTaM aSudDIrajastamaHsamudreko nAntareRa tapaHsamBedamapodyate sAndrasya nitAntaviralatA samBedaH, nanUpAdIyamAnamapi tapoDAtuvEzamyahetutayA yogapratipakza iti kaTaM tadupAya iti ata Aha--tacceti,
